headline: Executive order sets up a Climate Change Support Office within the federal government.
what_it_does: Based on its title, this order creates a new federal office called the Climate Change Support Office. No summary was provided, so details such as which agency houses the office, its staff, its budget, and its exact duties are not described here.

who_it_affects.group: Federal employees and agencies working on climate policy
who_it_affects.how: They may work with or within a new office set up to support climate change efforts.

when_it_takes_effect: Signed May 7, 2021; the effective date is not stated in the provided material.
